referents.why: Interrogative Ti (neuter singular) opening the question about the advantage; it refers to nothing, and no candidate is neuter singular.
Interrogative 'what' (τίς) is the predicate question word of the second question; the subject is 'the benefit' itself, so no candidate is referred to.

links.why: Two questions side by side asking the same thing, joined by e (or): an alternative.

cant_tell.why: It points back to the argument of chapter 2, which is not in this passage, so no clause here can be its host.
